articles.title: Trump Ties Saudi Nuclear Deal to Israel Recognition, Raising Stakes in the Middle East
articles.summary: President Trump says a U.S.-Saudi nuclear cooperation agreement hinges on Saudi Arabia joining the Abraham Accords and recognizing Israel. The deal aims for peaceful energy but stirs proliferation concerns.

articles.title: Federal Agency Scrubs Bike Safety Resources, Sparking Outcry from Experts
articles.summary: The FHWA has removed bike safety countermeasures and a crash analysis tool from its website after Secretary Duffy's anti-"DEI bike lane" push. Safety researchers warn this undermines proven road safety strategies.

articles.title: Oil Breaches $100 as Red Sea Attacks Reignite Supply Fears
articles.summary: Brent crude hit $100 a barrel after Houthi strikes on tankers threatened a key Saudi export route. The spike could fuel inflation and pressure central banks to keep interest rates elevated.
